name: mcp-x-articles
description: Publish Markdown files as X Articles via official X API v2.

X_OAUTH2_CLIENT_ID.description: X OAuth 2.0 Client ID under 'OAuth 2.0 Keys' in https://console.x.com -> Apps -> Keys and tokens.

X_OAUTH2_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional X OAuth 2.0 Client Secret under 'OAuth 2.0 Keys' in https://console.x.com -> Apps -> Keys and tokens (for confidential clients).

X_OAUTH2_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: Optional long-term OAuth 2.0 Refresh Token from 'OAuth 2.0 Keys -> Access Token -> Generate' in https://console.x.com (leave blank to authorize via browser PKCE).
